title: A partial close (live-review reduce, monitor partial) shrinks position_size and books NO realised pnl for the closed part; its only record (notes.live_review_actions / partial_closes) is shed by later 500-char notes rewrites
blocked_on: PR #25261 held for the manager's merge (Tier 2); backfill-partial-close-children run is a separate manager decision
clears_when: PR #25261 merged, then landed_unproven with observe = the next live partial close leaves a trades row setup_type=partial_close with a venue fill exit_price and pnl (diag journal), and the backfill dry-run printed on the VM
note: Filed by lane JOURNAL-TRUTH 2026-11-12. MEASURED on pkg-633f05fad1ee4c1d: LR-20261109T0828Z partial_close 0.5 was applied (bybit_2 ac3c1ec8 53.8 @1.0893 09:51Z; bybit_portfolio 9178f2b1 16239.2 @1.0836 10:52Z, venue order history). scripts/ops/live_review_apply.py writes only position_size=remaining plus notes.live_review_actions (qty, exit_price = mark, ESTIMATED; dump_capped 2000). The final rows 6982/6983 carry NO live_review_actions key (both _truncated by later dump_capped(...,500) writers; the key is an unprotected list), and 0 of the newest 600 journal rows carry it at all. So the closed half's realised P&L (gross ~+1.09 bybit_2, ~+433.6 bybit_portfolio here) is absent from journal pnl, and the record of the action is gone. order_monitor's verdict partial-close path (notes.partial_closes) has the same shape. Population (INFERRED, each not verified): in the newest 400 order_packages (2026-08-03..11-12), sized_qty_by_account vs summed journal position_size is exactly 0.5 for 27 bybit_1, 1 bybit_2 and 1 bybit_portfolio packages, the signature of a 50% reduce. Fix direction (Tier 2): book each partial close as its own closed journal row (an intent_reduce-style child row with venue fill price and pnl), or a protected cumulative realised field on the parent; pair it with DEMO-EXIT-FIRST-FILL-ATTRIBUTION, since that partial-close fill is exactly what the first-fill exit pricing then mis-attributes. Re-entry test: the next live-review partial close leaves a journal record with qty, venue fill price and realised pnl that survives the row's close. 2026-11-12 10:45Z lane JOURNAL-TRUTH: building on branch partial-close-child-rows (PR to follow, Tier 2 hold). Seam AGREED with lane CAP-PROP-VM-CLOSE (session_01AFoLuLZif73NzCZEY27pKE): trades rows use src/runtime/partial_close_journal.book_partial_close (one closed child row per partial close, setup_type partial_close, idempotent per close order id, fill price or pending_fill settled from the fills store). Prop VM accounts (tradeify_1, velotrade_1) journal to prop_fills via prop_journal.insert_fill, not trades, so the prop lane mirrors the same contract there (a closed prop_fills row per partial, external_order_id = close request id, exit_price_source venue_history, source prop_vm_close) under its row PROP-VM-PARTIAL-JOURNAL-QTY. One contract, implemented once per table; neither lane touches the other's files. 2026-11-12 11:10Z lane JOURNAL-TRUTH, backfill PREPARED, NOT RUN. Venue verification (diag bybit_raw_order_history per suspect's [open, close] window) of the 29 suspected packages: only 2 TRUE partials, 6982 bybit_2 (ac3c1ec8 53.8 @1.0893) and 6983 bybit_portfolio (9178f2b1 16239.2 @1.0836), plus 6983's exit fix 1.0836 -> 1.0629. The other 27 (all bybit_1) are NOT partials: their entry order filled the journal size, which is half of sized_qty_by_account; 7 of those show a reduce-only order for the whole position (a non-bracket full close). So my earlier '29 suspected' INFERENCE was wrong.
